title: Microsoft Purview Data Security Investigations: pull files into an investigation from audit log activity
notes: claim 103: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly says automation for assigning audit-search access is not documented, although Microsoft documents role-group membership management in PowerShell. It also treats every audit query as adding billed data, whereas investigators can cancel a query without adding its results to scope. The roadmap facts, supported activities, search limits and underlying storage and compute billing are supported.
